first.rationale: Current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrates that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful action. This directly addresses the activation decline without the downstream retention risk that memory_73 flagged for promotional pricing. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification lifted adoption, suggesting the funnel has capacity to improve. Memory_44 reminds us enterprise flows work well, but we lack dedicated enterprise sales capacity for a full enterprise_sales_assist experiment this week. Activation_messaging is a lower-risk lever that operates on existing users (higher conversion base) and aligns with our primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verification of memory_86 (onboarding completion mechanics) and memory_73 (retention risks of pricing moves) will confirm whether a sequential onboarding+activation combination is warranted, or if activation messaging alone can move the needle without the retention cliff that aggressive pricing created.
